d01-udah-stimulasi.note: Reassurance angle lifts it; still a familiar topic, so the hook does the work.

d16-protein-pasar.note: Contrarian 'nggak perlu salmon' hook; still close to d09, the weekly rotation is the new value.

d17-main-5-menit.note: Very doable; common topic, illustrations carry it.

w2e-d29-belum-ngomong.note: Worrying topic by nature; calm framing and the home slide help, but relief stays moderate.

w2n-tidur-aman.note: Clear send target (pasangan/pengasuh); safe sleep is saturated and co-sleeping is common, so the CTA stays gentle.

w2n-nangis-malam.note: Permission to put the baby down is the unexpected part; shaking warning stated once, gently, per AAP.

w2n-porsi-mpasi.note: Classic save chart; '2-3 sendok itu normal' gives the relief angle. Portion table is Kemenkes, not IDAI.

w2n-demam-kapan-dokter.note: Most useful save of the week but the hook is a principle, not a surprise. No medicine names or doses.
